Direction for questions:

Seven persons Andy, Bickel, Christian, Doyle, Enrique, Ferguson and Gayle are sitting in a row facing northwards. Further, the following information is given about their seating arrangement:
i. Andy and Gayle are sitting to the left of Christian.
ii. If Bickel and Doyle interchange their positions, then each of them gets exactly one new neighbour.
iii. Ferguson is three places away, to the left of Christian and to the right of Doyle.
iv. Enrique is sitting at the leftmost position.

If Doyle sits to the immediate left of Ferguson, then who sits to the immediate right of Ferguson?
